_metadata.description: Validate the target scenario's package.json against the component's declared @deps before adoption.

requirements.title: Component dep declarations are parsed from the @deps header field
requirements.description: Indexer parses the optional `@deps` field as JSON (object `{"react":"^18.0.0"}` OR array `[{"name":"react","range":"^18.0.0","kind":"peer"}]`). Missing field → empty array. Malformed JSON → observer error surfaced in the IndexComponents response. Parsed rows go into `component_dep_declarations` keyed by component id, component version, and dependency name. Indexer wires the deps recorder via `components.UpsertObserver` so each successful upsert re-syncs all version dep sets.

validation.notes: internal/deps/semver_test.go::TestParseHeaderField covers object/array/empty/malformed and optional kind parsing; sqlite_test.go verifies version-scoped dep-row replacement semantics.

requirements.title: On adopt, validator compares declared deps against target scenario's package.json
requirements.description: `DepsService.ValidateAdoption(component_id, scenario, version)` (Connect-RPC) reads the target's `package.json` via the storage resolver, resolves declarations for the requested adopted component version, runs semver intersection against each declared dep, and returns `ok | warn | block`. `block` fires when a major-version range cannot be satisfied or the target is unparseable; `warn` fires when a runtime/dev dep is missing or minor/patch ranges don't intersect. Peer dependencies are must-be-provided by the target scenario. AdoptionsService.Apply and Reapply invoke it server-side before writing, so UI, CLI, and direct RPC callers share the same enforcement.

validation.notes: internal/deps/service_test.go covers version-scoped adoption validation, peer-vs-runtime semantics, OK/Warn/Block folds, no-declarations OK, and scenario-pkg-missing error. semver_test.go::TestClassify covers ^/~/>=/exact range arithmetic.

requirements.title: Adoption UI surfaces dep verdicts and requires acknowledgement for warnings or blocks
requirements.description: Adoption modal shows the dep verdict before confirm. `ok` enables proceed; `warn` requires an acknowledgment checkbox; `block` shows the failing dependency and requires an explicit acknowledgement, which is forwarded as `override_validation` to the server.

validation.notes: features/adoptions/CreateAdoptionDialog.test.tsx: OK enables confirm + dispatches createAdoption; BLOCK lists the failing dep, requires acknowledgement, and forwards overrideValidation; WARN requires the acknowledgment checkbox before confirm enables.

requirements.title: Adoption writes enforce dependency and style-fit validation server-side
requirements.description: Before Apply or Reapply writes a target file, AdoptionsService invokes both dependency validation and design-style fit validation. A blocking dependency verdict returns FailedPrecondition unless the caller explicitly sets override_validation; the override never skips either validation call. The proto field is exposed through both the UI and CLI adoption commands.

validation.notes: api/internal/adoptions/service_test.go::TestService_ApplyAndReapply_BlockDependencyVerdictsUnlessExplicitlyOverridden proves both write paths reject block verdicts without an override, execute both validators, and allow a deliberate override. CLI and UI tests prove override forwarding.

requirements.title: Preview dependency runtime uses the deps range resolver
requirements.description: The live preview import map resolves non-React declared dependency ranges with `ResolveRangeToLatest` against locally installed UI workspace runtime candidates, then maps the selected version to a same-origin `/preview/runtime/npm/<package>@<version>/...` URL. Unresolvable ranges are reported as preview diagnostics instead of falling back to a third-party CDN or silently omitting the package.

validation.notes: api/handlers/preview/static_test.go covers same-origin non-React runtime URLs, resolver-backed version selection, independent import maps for conflicting ranges, and diagnostics for unavailable dependency ranges. api/internal/deps/semver_test.go covers the shared range grammar.
